+from typing import Any
+
+from click.utils import make_str
+
+
+def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate a record and return a normalized copy with its display value."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict) or "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict with a value")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not (key := key.strip()):
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": make_str(value), "enabled": enabled}

--- a/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
@@ -15,3 +15,19 @@ def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
         raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
     value = record["value"]
     return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": make_str(value), "enabled": enabled}
+
+
+def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare a list of records, requiring unique normalized keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared = []
+    keys: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in keys:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record key: {key!r}")
+        keys.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py

@@ -31,3 +31,12 @@ def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
         keys.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: object) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Group enabled display values by their normalized key's first character."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

+def merge(left: object, right: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Merge prepared records by key, preferring right-side records."""
+    merged = {item["key"]: item for item in batch(left)}
+    merged.update((item["key"], item) for item in batch(right))
+    return list(merged.values())
